svg.style: background:#ffffff; font-family:'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, sans-serif;
svg.text: Full A4 Sequence: User Journeys, 3-Point KYC Vetting, Proximity Search, Gate Verification & Overstay Poller
FLOW 1: CENTRALIZED AUTHENTICATION & UNIFIED DUAL-ROLE REGISTRATION
• Selects primary goal: Parking or Hosting.
• Unified account model removes multi-login pain.
• Proxies request securely to Keycloak Server.
• Angular Signals store token in secure memory.
FLOW 2: GARAGE SPOT LISTING, 3-POINT KYC VETTING & ADMIN APPROVAL
• Host enters address, road & bay size.
• Drops Leaflet pin at exact garage gate.
• Spot appears on Leaflet map immediately.
FLOW 3: PROXIMITY SEARCH, LEAFLET CLUSTERING & TRANSACTIONAL RESERVATION
• Runs on any browser; 0 native app install.
• Split feed displays hourly & daily rates.
• Digital Pass generated with License Plate.
FLOW 4: GATE ARRIVAL, SECURITY GUARD VERIFICATION & ENTRY CHECK-IN
• Guides driver directly to apartment gate.
• Driver displays Digital Pass on phone.
• Guard enters 6-digit code on web portal.
• Confirms validity and vehicle owner name.
• Opens gate barrier for safe parking.
FLOW 5: AUTOMATED OVERSTAY MONITORING, EXIT CHECK-OUT & REVENUE SETTLEMENT
• Guard inspects exit pass at boundary gate.
• Gate barrier opens; vehicle exits safely.
• Slot is physically vacant for next driver.
6. OPERATIONAL SUMMARY: ZERO-HARDWARE ADVANTAGE & COMMUNITY SECURITY
• No ultrasonic sensors, boom barriers or RFID tags required
• Runs on existing smartphones, browsers & GPS hardware
• Affordable for ordinary residential flat owner communities
• Strict 3-Point Admin KYC vetting eliminates fraud
• License Plate on Digital Pass gives guards 100% control
• Unregistered outside vehicles cannot enter compound
• ACID row locks guarantee 0% double-booking collision
• Spring Boot @Scheduled cron manages overstay automatically
• Sub-second search across Dhanmondi, Banani & Mirpur
